decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0905. Series context: trend strength 0.9996 and seasonal strength 0.2755; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 43.997.
